title: What You Can Order on Giftlaya
Fresh Flowers, Delivered the Same Day
content: Our flower delivery starts at ₹449. Every bouquet is sourced locally in the delivery city and arranged on the day it goes out, so roses, lilies, orchids, and mixed bouquets arrive fresh, not tired from travel. Order flowers online in Delhi, Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata, and most major cities — including midnight delivery for the anniversary you almost forgot.

Not sure which flower to send? Red roses are the safe answer for love — anniversaries, Valentine's Day, or no reason at all. Pink roses and carnations suit mothers, sisters, and teachers. Yellow roses and gerberas say congratulations without saying too much. White flowers carry sympathy and respect. When in doubt, a mixed bouquet covers every base.

title: Cake Delivery for Every Celebration
content: Online cake delivery starts at ₹649. Chocolate truffle, red velvet, butterscotch, black forest, photo cakes, and eggless options for every flavour. If you want something more special, browse theme cakes for kids' parties, cute little bento cakes for small celebrations, or first birthday cakes for the biggest little milestone. Midnight cake delivery is available in major cities, because a birthday starts at 12 AM, not at breakfast.

A quick sizing guide from experience: half a kilo serves four to six people, one kilo serves eight to twelve, and for a party of twenty or more, go for two kilos or a tiered theme cake. Ordering for someone who avoids eggs? Almost every flavour on Giftlaya has an eggless version at the same price.

title: Balloon Decoration at Home
content: This is what most first-time customers come for. Our balloon decoration packages start at ₹1,499, and the price includes the setup — a trained decorator comes to your home with all the material and finishes the job in one to two hours, before your guests arrive. Popular setups include birthday decoration, anniversary decoration, baby welcome decoration, romantic room decoration, and candle light dinner experiences.

Here is how a booking actually goes. You choose the package, pick your date and a time slot, and pay online. Our team calls or messages to confirm the address and any customisation — balloon colours, a name banner, the age number for a birthday. On the day, the decorator arrives in your chosen slot, sets everything up, takes your approval, and leaves before the surprise begins. If you are planning a baby shower or a proposal, book two to three days ahead — those setups take the most requests for customisation.

title: Personalised Gifts They Will Actually Keep
content: A gift with a name or a photo on it rarely gets regifted. Add a photograph to personalised mugs, photo cushions, or photo frames. Print a name on custom t-shirts or keychains. Or turn a couple's photo into a hand-drawn style caricature — a favourite for weddings and anniversaries.

title: Plants, Chocolates, and Gift Hampers
content: For gifts that last longer than a weekend, send indoor plants from ₹499 — money plants, snake plants, and lucky bamboo that survive busy owners. Chocolate gift packs work for every age and every festival. And when one gift is not enough, gift hampers combine sweets, snacks, and keepsakes in one box — also a practical option for corporate gifting in bulk.

title: Same Day, Midnight, or a Date You Choose
content: Every product page shows the delivery options available for it. Decorations and fresh items like cakes and flowers are delivered by our local teams in 100+ cities, with same-day slots in most of them — order by the afternoon and you can still make tonight's celebration. Courier-shipped gifts — like personalised items and hampers — reach most pincodes in India. Enter your pincode on the product page and we will tell you instantly whether we deliver there and when the order can reach you. Shipped orders come with tracking from dispatch to doorstep, so you are never left guessing where the gift is.

Planning ahead? You can schedule any order for a future date at checkout. Most customers book decorations two to three days early and same-day items on the day itself. For peak dates — Valentine's week, Mother's Day, Raksha Bandhan, New Year's Eve — booking early gets you the time slot you actually want.

title: Gifting Across India's Cities
content: Giftlaya's local teams handle fresh deliveries and decoration setups city by city. Birthday decoration in Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, and Kolkata are our busiest services, alongside flower delivery in Hyderabad, Gurgaon, and Noida. Living away from family is normal now — a son in Bangalore can have a cake and decoration ready at his parents' home in Kolkata without making a single phone call. That distance-closing is most of what we do every day.

title: Why Families Keep Coming Back
content: Giftlaya is run from Kolkata, with delivery and decoration teams across India. A few honest reasons customers stay with us:
On-time record. Celebration gifts are useless a day late. Our whole operation is built around the delivery slot you choose.
Real humans on support. WhatsApp and phone support before, during, and after delivery — not a chatbot loop.
Secure payments. Pay by UPI, card, or netbanking through a trusted payment gateway. No hidden charges at checkout.
Reward coins. Earn 10% back on every order as coins you can use on your next one.
Clear policies. Our cancellation and refund policy is published openly, so you know the rules before you book.

title: How Ordering Works
content: Three steps, five minutes:
Pick your city. Prices and same-day availability are shown for your location.
Choose the product and slot. Select the date, time slot, flavour, colour theme, or photo upload — whatever the product needs.
Pay securely and relax. You get confirmation right away, updates on WhatsApp, and live status in the My Orders section of your account.

title: Gift Ideas by Person
content: Stuck on what to get? Start with who it is for. For your wife: a surprise room decoration with her favourite flowers beats another handbag. For your husband: a birthday setup he would never plan for himself, plus a photo caricature of the two of you. For kids: theme decorations and cartoon cakes — pick the character, we do the rest. For parents living in another city: fresh flowers, a soft cake, and a video call while they cut it. For colleagues and clients: corporate hampers ordered in bulk with your company's branding.

title: A Gift for Every Date on the Calendar
content: Birthdays and anniversaries fill most of our calendar, but not all of it. Around February, Valentine's Day gifts and proposal decorations take over. In monsoon, Rakhi gifts travel to brothers and sisters across the country. Wedding season brings haldi and mehndi decorations, and December runs on festival decorations and year-end office parties. Whatever the date, someone has probably ordered for it here before you — and we know exactly how to deliver it.
Gifting starts here. Pick a city, pick a moment, and let Giftlaya handle the rest.
